title: Thyroid embryology, surgical relations and thyroglossal remnants
sec: Thyroid embryology, surgical relations and thyroglossal remnants · p898
guide: Trace endodermal thyroid descent and thyroglossal persistence. Connect the arterial diagram to nearby laryngeal nerves. Distinguish the preferred Sistrunk excision from incision that risks a persistent fistula.

title: Follicles, C cells and developmental transcription factors
sec: Follicles, C cells and developmental transcription factors · p899
guide: Separate follicular hormone synthesis from C-cell calcitonin secretion. Learn the timeline and transcription-factor associations while flagging the source’s overstatement that low TSH cannot cause significant hypothyroidism.

title: Thyroid hormone synthesis and transport defects
sec: Thyroid hormone synthesis and transport defects · p900
guide: Follow basolateral trapping, apical iodide transport, TPO-dependent chemistry, colloid storage and proteolytic release. NIS and pendrin are different transporters; a cold nodule is not synonymous with malignancy.

title: Iodine, deiodinases and non-thyroidal illness
sec: Iodine, deiodinases and non-thyroidal illness · p901
guide: Learn the iodine entries, isotope applications, deiodinase sites and inhibitors, then T3/T4 properties. Distinguish the source’s staged sick-euthyroid schematic from a mandatory laboratory trajectory in every ICU patient.
